'''Baby red dragons''' are located in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]]. They only attack with magic.

Low-level players seeking [[baby dragon bone]]s often choose to fight [[baby blue dragon]]s instead as aggressive [[wild dog]]s and 875 coins to gain entry to the area deters many players. However, wild dogs are not aggressive to players with 71+ combat. These monsters, like all [[chromatic dragons]], are best attacked using ranged attacks.
